profile_text.body:
Read is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA. The company describes itself as the fastest growing AI meeting assistant ever, offering real-time transcription, smart summaries, and AI-powered search and discovery across meetings, messages, emails, CRM systems, and documents. Its site positions the product as a platform-agnostic AI copilot that connects across a range of workplace tools to deliver unified insights.

The company's primary product, Read.ai, falls in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and centers on meeting analytics, engagement scoring, wellness insights, and handling of behavioral data privacy. Read.ai's integrations are presented as a core part of its value proposition, allowing it to draw context from a broad set of content sources rather than operating within a single platform.

The held facts show Read has a California law exposure count of 174, suggesting meaningful legal activity in that jurisdiction, though no specific cases are recorded. The MCP registry entries associated with the Read name are largely unrelated third-party servers sharing similar naming conventions rather than products attributable to the company itself.
